svg.text: One pallet, the instant a tooth lands on it (exit pallet, default settings)

g.text: locking face still ahead of the
tooth when it lands — the margin
room for the swing to carry
down it and pushes the pallet
anchor arbor, so resting on it
The acting face is one edge with a corner in it: the short locking face that holds the tooth still, then the long
impulse face it slides down. Lock sets the locking face; lift sets how far the impulse face swings the anchor.
